title: Heart with a smiling face
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="heartGlow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b8a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e6395a"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Heart main shape -->
  <path d="M50 82 C50 82 16 58 16 38 C16 24 26 16 38 16 C44 16 48 20 50 26 C52 20 56 16 62 16 C74 16 84 24 84 38 C84 58 50 82 50 82 Z" fill="url(#heartGlow)" stroke="#ffa0b4" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="34" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.65" transform="rotate(-25 34 34)"/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="42" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="#2a0a14"/>
  <ellipse cx="39.5" cy="40" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="42" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="#2a0a14"/>
  <ellipse cx="63.5" cy="40" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 54 Q50 64 60 54" fill="none" stroke="#2a0a14" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="50" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#ff8fa8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="50" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#ff8fa8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
